tokens.help: Primary actions use bg-brandcolor-primary text-brandcolor-white hover:bg-brandcolor-primaryhover rounded-md. Label is 1–3 words.
Cards: border-brandcolor-strokeweak bg-brandcolor-white p-card-pad-default rounded-lg shadow-card. One outer inset only.
Stacks use gap-micro or gap-tight. Section breaks use gap-section or gap-hero. Prefer theme spacing over p-4/gap-2.
Headings text-brandcolor-textstrong. Body/helper text-brandcolor-textweak. Never paste the full user brief into a title.
Inputs: border-brandcolor-strokestrong focus:border-brandcolor-textstrong focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 text-brandcolor-textstrong.
